name: Puerto Rico
notes: Puerto Rico supports digital ID in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Samsung Wallet is not currently supported.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select Puerto Rico from the list.
Scan the front and back of your Puerto Rico driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to Puerto Rico DTOP. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your Puerto Rico driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
Puerto Rico DTOP will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.
